{{Otheruses|Rudd}}
'''Rudd''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Rudd thought the [[PackTrack 41LT-R]] was not just a good [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], but was also a good companion for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] since they often traded on low-technology [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and needed assistance.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
